title: CreoleVal: Multilingual Multitask Benchmarks for Creoles

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking and evaluating the zero-shot cross-lingual transfer learning performance of pre-trained multilingual language models (like mBERT, XLM-R, and mT5) across 8 NLP tasks on up to 28 historically marginalized and under-resourced Creole languages.

Comparing reading comprehension model performance on Haitian Creole using both direct literal translations and culturally localized translations (which substitute foreign concepts with culturally relevant names, places, and activities) to evaluate progress in cross-cultural NLP.
